name: David Rosen
abstract_title: Songs of the Self: Autobiographically Salient Music Shapes Emotion, Altered States of Consciousness, and Transient Well-Being
abstract: Music can evoke autobiographical memories that are vivid, emotionally rich, and tied to identity and well-being. Music-evoked autobiographical memories (MEAMs) share key phenomenological features with therapeutic experiences in psychedelic-assisted therapy (PAT), evoking vivid imagery, heightened emotion, and psychological insight, yet their role in shaping music’s impact on emotion, altered states, and enduring outcomes in the context of PAT has not been systematically examined. authors: David Rosen, Riddhima Chandra, Frederick Barrett
